name: Westfield Topanga
demographics: Westfield Topanga attracts an affluent, fashion-conscious demographic from the San Fernando Valley and surrounding West Los Angeles communities, with visitors typically in the 25-54 age range and above-average household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws from upscale neighborhoods including Woodland Hills, Calabasas, and Encino, with shoppers seeking premium brands and luxury experiences. The center appeals to both families and young professionals who value high-end retail, designer fashion, and elevated dining options, with shopping patterns reflecting a preference for experiential retail and lifestyle amenities.
description: Westfield Topanga stands as a premier luxury shopping destination in the San Fernando Valley, located at 6600 Topanga Canyon Boulevard in Los Angeles. This upscale regional mall features an impressive collection of high-end retailers and luxury brands, including Prada, Balenciaga, Bottega Veneta, Saint Laurent, Valentino, Cartier, Rolex, Omega, Celine, and Dolce & Gabbana. The center offers a sophisticated shopping experience across multiple levels, complemented by elevated dining options such as STK Steakhouse, JINYA Ramen Bar, California Pizza Kitchen, Chubby Cattle, and the unique Topanga Social concept. Entertainment amenities include an AMC Theatres complex, while modern conveniences feature 27 electric vehicle charging stations from Electrify America and Chargepoint, free Wi-Fi throughout the property, and a dedicated Westfield mobile app for enhanced visitor experience. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM and a strong 4.5-star rating from over 15,000 reviews, Westfield Topanga has established itself as a go-to destination for discerning shoppers seeking luxury brands, contemporary fashion, and upscale lifestyle experiences in the Los Angeles area.
summary: Westfield Topanga is an upscale regional mall in Los Angeles featuring luxury brands like Prada, Balenciaga, Cartier, and Rolex alongside elevated dining and entertainment options. The center offers a sophisticated shopping experience with modern amenities including 27 EV charging stations and operates daily from 10 AM to 9 PM.
